description: Generate robot identities — model numbers (RX-7742), unit designations, or friendly bot names for your machines.

faqs.a: Model numbers use series prefixes like RX, MK, AX plus random digits (e.g. RX-7742); designations add a friendly nickname.
faqs.q: What is the difference between the styles?

faqs.a: Unit designations combine a label like “Unit JX-9” with a callsign nickname in quotes.
Click any result or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a result?

howto: Pick a style: model number, designation, or friendly name.
Press Generate, then click any result to copy it.
title: Robot Name Generator
